class DiagnoseFromSymptomsModule(dspy.Module):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()

        self.labels = [
            'allergy', 'arthritis', 'bronchial asthma', 'cervical spondylosis',
            'chicken pox', 'common cold', 'dengue', 'diabetes', 'drug reaction',
            'fungal infection', 'gastroesophageal reflux disease', 'hypertension',
            'impetigo', 'jaundice', 'malaria', 'migraine', 'peptic ulcer disease',
            'pneumonia', 'psoriasis', 'typhoid', 'urinary tract infection',
            'varicose veins',
        ]

        instructions = (
            "You are a clinical triage classifier. Given a patient's free-text description of "
            "their symptoms, choose exactly ONE disease label from this closed list:\n"
            "allergy, arthritis, bronchial asthma, cervical spondylosis, chicken pox, common cold, "
            "dengue, diabetes, drug reaction, fungal infection, gastroesophageal reflux disease, "
            "hypertension, impetigo, jaundice, malaria, migraine, peptic ulcer disease, pneumonia, "
            "psoriasis, typhoid, urinary tract infection, varicose veins.\n\n"
            "Method: list the distinctive symptoms mentioned, then pick the single label whose "
            "classic symptom set best covers ALL of them (not just one salient symptom). Weight the "
            "rarer / more specific symptoms more heavily than generic ones like fatigue or headache.\n\n"
            "Key discriminators (use these; they resolve the most common confusions):\n"
            "- hypertension: headache WITH chest pain, dizziness, loss of balance/unsteadiness, and "
            "trouble concentrating or 'lack of focus'. Chest pain + loss of balance + poor "
            "concentration alongside headache means hypertension, NOT migraine.\n"
            "- migraine: throbbing/one-sided headache with visual disturbances, acidity/indigestion, "
            "nausea/vomiting, sensitivity to light (photophobia), stiff neck, depression or "
            "irritability. Migraine does NOT feature chest pain.\n"
            "- cervical spondylosis: neck/back-of-neck pain, stiffness, dizziness, weakness in limbs, "
            "loss of balance; no headache-with-nausea pattern and no chest pain.\n"
            "- diabetes: excessive thirst, frequent urination, fatigue, weight loss, blurred vision, "
            "slow-healing wounds.\n"
            "- urinary tract infection: burning or painful urination, urgency with only small amounts "
            "of urine, foul-smelling or cloudy urine, bladder discomfort.\n"
            "- gastroesophageal reflux disease: heartburn, acid regurgitation, difficulty swallowing, "
            "chest burning after meals, cough, sour taste.\n"
            "- peptic ulcer disease: gnawing/burning stomach pain often relieved or worsened by food, "
            "abdominal fullness, vomiting, passing gas, internal itching of the stomach.\n"
            "- arthritis: swollen and stiff joints, muscle weakness, movement stiffness, painful walking.\n"
            "- allergy: sneezing, watery eyes, itching, chills, continuous sneezing after exposure.\n"
            "- drug reaction: skin rash/itching or stomach upset appearing after starting a medication.\n"
            "- fungal infection: itching, skin rash, nodal skin eruptions, patches in skin folds.\n"
            "- psoriasis: silvery scaly patches, dry flaking skin, joint pain, inflammatory nails, "
            "small dents in nails.\n"
            "- impetigo: red sores/blisters around nose and mouth oozing yellow fluid, crusting.\n"
            "- chicken pox: itchy fluid-filled blisters over the body with fever, fatigue, loss of appetite.\n"
            "- dengue: high fever with severe joint/muscle pain, pain behind the eyes, rash, headache.\n"
            "- malaria: cyclical high fever with chills and sweating, vomiting, muscle pain.\n"
            "- typhoid: sustained fever, abdominal pain, constipation or diarrhea, headache, "
            "toxic look, belly pain.\n"
            "- jaundice: yellowing of skin/eyes, dark urine, itching, abdominal pain, weight loss.\n"
            "- pneumonia: fever with chills, productive cough, chest pain when breathing, "
            "rapid or difficult breathing, fatigue.\n"
            "- bronchial asthma: wheezing, shortness of breath, cough worse at night, chest tightness "
            "without fever.\n"
            "- common cold: runny nose, sore throat, congestion, sneezing, mild cough, low fever.\n"
            "- varicose veins: visible/bulging veins in the legs, leg cramps, swelling, bruising, "
            "heaviness after standing.\n\n"
            "Rules:\n"
            "1. Output only one label, spelled exactly as in the list, all lowercase.\n"
            "2. Never invent a label outside the list and never output multiple labels or hedging text.\n"
            "3. If several diseases share a symptom, decide using the symptom that only one of them "
            "explains (e.g., chest pain, visible veins, yellow eyes, oozing sores).\n"
        )

        self.diagnose = dspy.ChainOfThought(dspy.Signature(
            "symptoms: str -> disease: Literal['allergy', 'arthritis', 'bronchial asthma', "
            "'cervical spondylosis', 'chicken pox', 'common cold', 'dengue', 'diabetes', "
            "'drug reaction', 'fungal infection', 'gastroesophageal reflux disease', 'hypertension', "
            "'impetigo', 'jaundice', 'malaria', 'migraine', 'peptic ulcer disease', 'pneumonia', "
            "'psoriasis', 'typhoid', 'urinary tract infection', 'varicose veins']",
            instructions,
        ))

    def forward(self, **inputs):
        def normalize(raw: str, labels: list) -> str:
            """Map a raw model label string onto the closest allowed disease label."""
            text = str(raw or "").strip().strip("'\"").lower()
            if text in labels:
                return text
            for lab in labels:
                if lab in text:
                    return lab
            # token-overlap fallback
            words = set(w for w in text.replace("-", " ").split() if w)
            best, best_score = None, 0
            for lab in labels:
                score = len(words & set(lab.split()))
                if score > best_score:
                    best, best_score = lab, score
            return best if best is not None else labels[0]

        symptoms = inputs.get("symptoms", "")
        out = self.diagnose(symptoms=symptoms)
        return dspy.Prediction(disease=normalize(getattr(out, "disease", ""), self.labels))

class DiagnoseFromSymptomsModule(dspy.Module):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()

        self.labels = [
            'allergy', 'arthritis', 'bronchial asthma', 'cervical spondylosis',
            'chicken pox', 'common cold', 'dengue', 'diabetes', 'drug reaction',
            'fungal infection', 'gastroesophageal reflux disease', 'hypertension',
            'impetigo', 'jaundice', 'malaria', 'migraine', 'peptic ulcer disease',
            'pneumonia', 'psoriasis', 'typhoid', 'urinary tract infection',
            'varicose veins',
        ]

        label_list = ", ".join(self.labels)

        self.extract = dspy.Predict(dspy.Signature(
            "symptoms: str -> key_features: str",
            "You are a clinical triage assistant. Read the patient's free-text complaint and rewrite it as a "
            "compact, comma-separated list of the symptom facts ACTUALLY stated or clearly implied. Do not "
            "diagnose and do not invent symptoms.\n\n"
            "Always make these specific determinations explicit, because they decide the diagnosis:\n"
            "1. SKIN: is there any rash, spots, blisters, sores, pus pimples, crusts, scaly/flaky patches, "
            "bumps/nodules, or discoloured patches? Say where (whole body vs localized) and whether it itches. "
            "If the skin is only described as dry, or there is only swelling/puffiness, that is NOT a rash.\n"
            "2. FEVER: none / mild / high or 'severe', and whether there is shivering, chills, or "
            "sweating/perspiring.\n"
            "3. RESPIRATORY: cough (dry vs with mucus/phlegm), sputum colour (rusty/brown/blood-tinged?), "
            "breathlessness, wheeze, fast/pounding heartbeat, chest pain; and separately the classic cold "
            "markers: sneezing, runny or stuffy nose, sinus pressure, watery/red eyes, swollen lymph nodes.\n"
            "4. GI: abdominal/stomach pain and whether it BURNS or is linked to eating, spicy food, or lying "
            "down; heartburn, acid/sour regurgitation, indigestion; nausea/vomiting; diarrhoea or constipation; "
            "loss of appetite; weakness.\n"
            "5. HEAD: headache (one-sided/throbbing?), pain behind the eyes, blurred vision or visual "
            "disturbance, light/sound sensitivity, dizziness, loss of balance, trouble concentrating, anxiety.\n"
            "6. OTHER: yellow skin/eyes, dark urine, burning/foul urine, thirst, frequent urination, weight "
            "loss, joint/neck/back/leg complaints, bulging leg veins, any medicine or drug mentioned as a "
            "trigger.\n\n"
            "Finish with an 'ABSENT:' clause listing which of these hallmarks are NOT mentioned: rash, fever, "
            "chills/sweating, cough/sputum, breathlessness, cold markers (sneezing/runny nose/watery eyes), "
            "headache, abdominal pain, urinary symptoms. Output only the list."
        ))

        self.classify = dspy.ChainOfThought(dspy.Signature(
            "symptoms: str, key_features: str -> disease: str",
            "Classify the patient's complaint into EXACTLY ONE disease from this closed list: "
            + label_list + ".\n"
            "Answer with the label in lowercase, spelled exactly as in the list, and nothing else.\n\n"
            "Reason only from what the patient ACTUALLY reports; absent hallmarks are as informative as present "
            "ones.\n\n"
            "TOP-LEVEL TRIAGE (apply in this order):\n"
            "A. If ANY rash, spots, blisters, sores, pus-pimples, crusts, scaly/flaky patches, bumps/nodules or "
            "discoloured skin patches is described, the answer MUST be a skin-capable disease: chicken pox, "
            "dengue, drug reaction, fungal infection, psoriasis or impetigo. NEVER answer allergy or common "
            "cold when a rash is described — allergy in this task never has a rash, only dry skin, puffiness, "
            "throat tickle/swelling and vague malaise.\n"
            "B. If the complaint is dominated by digestive trouble, decide by the QUALITY of the pain: burning "
            "stomach/chest pain, heartburn, acid or sour regurgitation, pain tied to eating/spicy food/lying "
            "down => peptic ulcer disease or gastroesophageal reflux disease. Non-burning belly ache with "
            "vomiting, weakness, poor appetite, diarrhoea or constipation, headache or fever => typhoid.\n"
            "C. If the complaint is dominated by breathing, decide by systemic toxicity: sweating, shivering "
            "chills, racing/pounding heart, chest pain or rusty/brown/blood-tinged sputum => pneumonia; "
            "otherwise cough (even with mucus) + breathlessness/wheeze + fatigue, with or without fever, => "
            "bronchial asthma.\n\n"
            "HALLMARK PROFILES:\n"
            "- allergy: vague, mild, multi-system complaints with NO hallmark and NO rash — tiredness, throat "
            "tickle/soreness or throat swelling, dry skin, swelling/puffiness around the eyes, feeling "
            "feverish, muscle aches or cramps, lightheadedness, nausea, chest tightness or trouble breathing at "
            "night, stuffiness. Choose allergy for such diffuse pictures instead of forcing an infection.\n"
            "- common cold: requires the classic cold cluster — sneezing, runny or stuffy nose, watery/red "
            "eyes, sinus pressure, throat phlegm/mucus, swollen lymph nodes, loss of smell WITH those. Without "
            "at least one of those markers it is NOT a cold.\n"
            "- bronchial asthma: cough (often with mucus), progressive breathlessness/difficulty breathing, "
            "wheeze, fatigue, sometimes high fever — but NO sweating, NO shivering, NO racing heart, NO "
            "rusty/brown sputum.\n"
            "- pneumonia: fever WITH sweating and shivering chills, breathlessness, fast heart rate, chest "
            "pain, rusty/brown/blood-tinged sputum.\n"
            "- malaria: high fever with chills AND sweating/perspiring, vomiting or nausea, headache, muscle "
            "aches; no pain behind the eyes.\n"
            "- dengue: high or 'severe' fever with body/muscle/joint pain, severe headache, pain behind the "
            "eyes, and/or a RED, SWOLLEN rash with loss of appetite. Rash + severe fever + body ache = dengue.\n"
            "- typhoid: fever, headache, belly pain, nausea/vomiting, weakness, poor appetite, watery "
            "foul-smelling diarrhoea or constipation. Any GI illness with fever, headache, diarrhoea or marked "
            "weakness is typhoid, not an ulcer.\n"
            "- chicken pox: rash/spots anywhere on the body (trunk, arms, legs) TOGETHER with malaise — "
            "itching, fatigue, loss of appetite, nausea, mild fever or headache. Rash + tiredness + poor "
            "appetite + nausea = chicken pox.\n"
            "- impetigo: LOCALIZED sores, blisters, pus-filled pimples or yellow crusts (often on/near the "
            "face or nose), usually with fever; not a generalized itchy eruption.\n"
            "- fungal infection: itching with skin bumps/nodules ('little balls', lumps) and/or patches a "
            "DIFFERENT COLOUR than the surrounding skin.\n"
            "- psoriasis: well-defined red, dry, flaky/silvery scaly PATCHES that spread, plus at least one of: "
            "inflamed or pitted nails, joint pain, patches worse at night, skin peeling in defined plaques.\n"
            "- drug reaction: rash and itching starting after a medicine, OR a systemic upset — fever, "
            "dizziness/wooziness, pounding heart, blurred vision, mental fog, poor concentration or memory, "
            "stomach pain, burning urination. Generalized 'itching all over' with rashes and no nail/joint "
            "involvement favours drug reaction over psoriasis.\n"
            "- hypertension: headache with dizziness, loss of balance, TROUBLE CONCENTRATING, anxiety or "
            "nervousness, chest pain, stress.\n"
            "- migraine: one-sided throbbing headache with blurred vision/visual disturbance, sensitivity to "
            "light or sound, nausea/vomiting, stiff neck, acidity.\n"
            "- cervical spondylosis: neck/back/shoulder pain and stiffness, dizziness when moving the neck, "
            "weakness or numbness in the limbs.\n"
            "- arthritis: painful, swollen, stiff joints, worse with movement, difficulty walking.\n"
            "- peptic ulcer disease: BURNING stomach pain related to eating, spicy food or lying down, "
            "heartburn, indigestion, nausea, passing gas — WITHOUT fever, diarrhoea or headache.\n"
            "- gastroesophageal reflux disease: burning chest/heartburn, acid or sour regurgitation, ulcers on "
            "the tongue, cough, vomiting after meals or when lying down.\n"
            "- jaundice: yellow skin or eyes, dark urine, itching, fatigue, weight loss, abdominal pain.\n"
            "- diabetes: excessive thirst, frequent urination, increased hunger, weight loss, fatigue, blurred "
            "vision, tingling/tremor, slow-healing wounds.\n"
            "- urinary tract infection: burning, foul-smelling, bloody or cloudy urine, urgency or bladder "
            "control problems.\n"
            "- varicose veins: bulging, swollen, visible leg veins, leg pain on standing, cramps, aching.\n\n"
            "ERROR-PREVENTION RULES: never answer allergy or common cold when a rash is present; never answer "
            "pneumonia without sweating/shivering/fast heart/rusty sputum; never answer peptic ulcer disease "
            "when there is fever, headache, diarrhoea or marked weakness without burning pain (that is "
            "typhoid); never answer common cold without a nasal/sinus/eye/lymph marker (a vague tired, achy, "
            "feverish picture is allergy); never answer migraine for dizziness plus poor concentration and "
            "anxiety without one-sided/throbbing headache or visual/light-sound features (that is "
            "hypertension); never answer psoriasis when there are nodules or differently-coloured patches "
            "(fungal infection) or when itching is generalized with no nail/joint involvement (drug reaction)."
        ))

        self.adjudicate = dspy.ChainOfThought(dspy.Signature(
            "symptoms: str, key_features: str, candidates: str, decision_rule: str -> disease: str",
            "You are given a patient's complaint, a SHORT LIST of easily-confused candidate diagnoses, and a "
            "decision rule written specifically for that confusion. Follow the decision rule literally: it "
            "encodes how these diseases actually differ in this dataset and overrides your general intuition.\n"
            "Pick exactly one candidate from the candidate list. Answer with that label in lowercase, spelled "
            "exactly as in the candidate list, and nothing else.\n\n"
            "General adjudication principles:\n"
            "- Use only symptoms the patient actually reports; do not assume unmentioned hallmarks.\n"
            "- Choose the candidate whose REQUIRED hallmark is present, not the one that merely could fit.\n"
            "- A described rash, spots, blisters, sores, crusts, scaly patches or skin bumps rules OUT allergy "
            "and common cold entirely.\n"
            "- Vague, mild, multi-system complaints with no hallmark at all (tiredness, throat tickle or "
            "swelling, dry skin, puffy eyes, feeling feverish, aches, dizziness, nausea, night-time chest "
            "tightness) are allergy when allergy is a candidate.\n"
            "- If the decision rule and your intuition disagree, obey the decision rule."
        ))

    def forward(self, **inputs):
        symptoms = inputs.get("symptoms", "") or ""
        text = str(symptoms).lower()

        confusion_groups = {
            'allergy': ['allergy', 'common cold', 'bronchial asthma', 'drug reaction'],
            'common cold': ['common cold', 'allergy', 'chicken pox', 'bronchial asthma'],
            'bronchial asthma': ['bronchial asthma', 'pneumonia', 'common cold', 'allergy'],
            'pneumonia': ['pneumonia', 'bronchial asthma'],
            'dengue': ['dengue', 'malaria', 'chicken pox', 'typhoid'],

            'psoriasis': ['psoriasis', 'drug reaction', 'fungal infection'],
            'drug reaction': ['drug reaction', 'psoriasis', 'fungal infection', 'chicken pox'],
            'peptic ulcer disease': ['peptic ulcer disease', 'gastroesophageal reflux disease', 'typhoid'],
            'gastroesophageal reflux disease': ['gastroesophageal reflux disease', 'peptic ulcer disease'],
            'hypertension': ['hypertension', 'migraine', 'cervical spondylosis'],

        group_rules = {

            "systemic upset (dizziness, pounding heart, mental fog) => drug reaction."
        )

        def has(*words) -> bool:
            """True if any of the given lowercase substrings occurs in the patient's text."""
            return any(w in text for w in words)

        def normalize(raw) -> str:
            """Map a raw LM string onto the closest allowed disease label, or '' if no match."""
            if raw is None:
                return ""
            t = str(raw).strip().strip('."\'` ').lower()
            if not t:
                return ""
            for label in self.labels:
                if t == label:
                    return label
            best = ""
            for label in self.labels:
                if label in t and len(label) > len(best):
                    best = label
            if best:
                return best
            aliases = {
                'gerd': 'gastroesophageal reflux disease',
                'acid reflux': 'gastroesophageal reflux disease',
                'reflux': 'gastroesophageal reflux disease',
                'ulcer': 'peptic ulcer disease',
                'asthma': 'bronchial asthma',
                'uti': 'urinary tract infection',
                'varicose': 'varicose veins',
                'chickenpox': 'chicken pox',
                'cold': 'common cold',
                'spondylosis': 'cervical spondylosis',
                'allergic': 'allergy',
                'fungal': 'fungal infection',
            }
            for key, label in aliases.items():
                if key in t:
                    return label
            return ""

        def ask_adjudicate(cands, rule, fallback):
            """Run the adjudicator over a candidate list with a pair-specific rule; return a valid label."""
            try:
                out = self.adjudicate(
                    symptoms=symptoms,
                    key_features=features,
                    candidates=", ".join(cands),
                    decision_rule=rule,
                )
                pick = normalize(out.disease)
                if pick in cands:
                    return pick
            except Exception:
                pass
            return fallback

        # --- deterministic evidence flags -------------------------------------------------
        has_rash = has('rash', 'rashes', 'hives', 'blister', 'pimple', 'pustule', 'spot',
                       'lesion', 'bump', 'patch', 'sore', 'crust', 'scal', 'flak',
                       'eruption', 'pox', 'boils')
        pneumonia_marks = has('sweat', 'perspir', 'shiver', 'chill', 'rusty', 'brown',
                              'blood', 'racing', 'pounding', 'palpit', 'fast heart',
                              'rapid heart', 'heart rate', 'chest pain')
        pud_marks = has('burn', 'heartburn', 'acid', 'reflux', 'regurgit', 'indigestion',
                        'after eating', 'when i eat', 'after i eat', 'spicy', 'sour',
                        'lie down', 'lying down', 'gas', 'bloat')
        typhoid_marks = has('fever', 'diarrh', 'loose motion', 'constipat', 'weak',
                            'headache', 'temperature', 'chills', 'tired', 'exhaust')
        cold_marks = has('sneez', 'runny nose', 'running nose', 'stuffy', 'blocked nose',
                         'congest', 'nasal', 'watery eye', 'red eye', 'sinus', 'phlegm',
                         'mucus', 'lymph', 'nose is')
        migraine_marks = has('throbb', 'one side', 'one-sided', 'half of my head',
                             'blurred', 'blurry', 'vision', 'light', 'sound', 'aura',
                             'pulsat')
        htn_marks = has('concentrat', 'balance', 'anxi', 'nervous', 'dizz', 'stress',
                        'chest pain', 'focus')

        # --- stage 1: feature extraction --------------------------------------------------
        features = ""
        try:
            features = str(self.extract(symptoms=symptoms).key_features or "")
        except Exception:
            features = ""

        # --- stage 2: first-pass classification -------------------------------------------
        first = ""
        try:
            first = normalize(self.classify(symptoms=symptoms, key_features=features).disease)
        except Exception:
            first = ""

        final = first if first else "allergy"

        # --- stage 3: deterministic guards for the recurring confusions -------------------
        guard_fired = False

        if final in ('allergy', 'common cold') and has_rash:
            skin_candidates = ['chicken pox', 'dengue', 'drug reaction',
                               'fungal infection', 'psoriasis', 'impetigo']
            final = ask_adjudicate(skin_candidates, skin_rule, 'chicken pox')
            guard_fired = True
        elif final == 'pneumonia' and not pneumonia_marks:
            final = 'bronchial asthma'
            guard_fired = True
        elif final == 'peptic ulcer disease' and not pud_marks and typhoid_marks:
            final = 'typhoid'
            guard_fired = True
        elif final == 'common cold' and not cold_marks:
            final = 'allergy'
            guard_fired = True
        elif final == 'migraine' and not migraine_marks and htn_marks:
            final = 'hypertension'
            guard_fired = True

        # --- stage 4: adjudicate within the confusion group -------------------------------
        if not guard_fired:
            candidates = confusion_groups.get(final, [])
            if len(candidates) > 1:
                rule = group_rules.get(final, skin_rule if has_rash else "")
                final = ask_adjudicate(candidates, rule, final)
                # re-apply the strongest deterministic guards after adjudication
                if final == 'pneumonia' and not pneumonia_marks:
                    final = 'bronchial asthma'
                if final == 'peptic ulcer disease' and not pud_marks and typhoid_marks:
                    final = 'typhoid'
                if final in ('allergy', 'common cold') and has_rash:
                    final = 'chicken pox'
                if final == 'common cold' and not cold_marks:
                    final = 'allergy'

        if final not in self.labels:
            final = "allergy"

        return dspy.Prediction(disease=final)
